candidates.title: Notify a restaurant when an order arrives

demandEvidence.chore: Send a WhatsApp notification when a new order is placed on a restaurant website.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .

ease.reason: A student can mock an order event and draft a notification; the discussion supplies no implementation reference for WhatsApp delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent restaurants might pay for timely order alerts; this request establishes no paying customers or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week prototype can format sample order alerts, while real website integration and delivery need testing and authorization.

autonomy.reason: A configured event could trigger a repeatable alert; a person must verify order data, delivery failures and live operation.

evidence.reason: The public request names restaurant website orders and WhatsApp notifications but gives no frequency, requirements or implementation proof.

candidates.reason: Concrete request supports a narrow mock notification experiment, but the implementation evidence is absent and the provisional mean is 23/5 = 4.6, below 6.
